notice: Methodology application profiles. The CLI only SELECTS a profile (gtt-project.sh profile set); what Light, Medium and Hard MEAN is defined here, by the Bootstrap. `gates` are machine-enforced by the deterministic checks; `semantics` and `relaxes` are consumed by agents through the bootstrap skill and AGENTS.md (instruction plane) - each rule says which. No profile weakens an invariant.
after_freeze: Selecting a LESS strict profile in a frozen project is refused: it is a governed change (change request -> proposal -> human decision). Selecting a stricter one is allowed.

invariants.statement: Agents prepare; only a human decides, ratifies and freezes. No profile, ADE or Primary ADE changes that.
[PROPUESTA] never appears inside governed context; [FUENTE], [VACIO] and [CONFLICTO] must be well formed wherever they are used.
Sources -> grounding -> evidence dossier -> reasoning -> proposal -> human decision. Reasoning does not receive raw sources in a way that bypasses grounding.
A proposal is never a decision and is never written as one.
A conflict between sources is exposed, never silently resolved; an unresolved [CONFLICTO] refuses freeze.
An OPEN gap is scoped, visible and authorises nothing; a BLOCKING gap refuses freeze.
Freeze is a human ratification; there is no unfreeze shortcut. A frozen L0/L1 is changed only through the governed path.
GTTGuard-protected artifacts and the frozen governed context are never modified autonomously.
A selected source is not a governed authority; authority and precedence are declared, never inferred.

semantics.proposal_rigor: A proposal may be a short note in gtt-domain/proposals/; alternatives and risk may be one line each.
semantics.confirmation_requirements: Confirmation A (source) and Confirmation B (context) stay explicit and separate, but may be requested in the same interaction.
semantics.documentation_depth: solution-vision, stack and constraints are enough to freeze; architecture, principles and glossary may stay minimal.
semantics.adr_expectations: An ADR is expected only for a structural change to what is already frozen.
semantics.change_process: Change request is required for governed context; routine implementation needs none.
semantics.validation_gates: gtt-validate.sh; provenance policy advisory; warnings do not block freeze.
semantics.freeze_expectations: Freeze when the context is real and no BLOCKING gap or unresolved conflict remains.
semantics.audit_requirements: None scheduled; run gtt-audit on demand.
semantics.promotion_rigor: Human reviews the promotion script output before running it.
semantics.evidence_requirements: Record what was run only when a claim about it is made.

relaxes.how: Only solution-vision, stack and constraints must be non-template before freeze; the other three files may stay minimal but must not contain template placeholders.
No ADR for changes that do not alter frozen governed context.
Confirmation A and B may be asked in one exchange; each still needs its own explicit human answer.

semantics.proposal_rigor: Full proposal: current decision, requested change, reason, impact, risk, alternatives.
semantics.confirmation_requirements: Confirmation A and B, each explicit and separate.
semantics.documentation_depth: All six governed context files real (no template text) before freeze.
semantics.adr_expectations: An ADR for every architectural decision that changes governed context.
semantics.change_process: Change request -> proposal -> human decision -> promotion package -> human execution.
semantics.validation_gates: gtt-validate.sh including provenance (advisory), integrity and stack checks.
semantics.freeze_expectations: Freeze after both confirmations; BLOCKING gaps and unresolved conflicts resolved; OPEN gaps scoped.
semantics.audit_requirements: gtt-audit before a release or after a large merge.
semantics.promotion_rigor: Promotion package: ADR draft, full affected context, human-run script with diffs.
semantics.evidence_requirements: Verification claims are classified (STATIC / RUNTIME VERIFIED, DOCUMENTED ONLY, NO EVIDENCE) when recorded.

semantics.proposal_rigor: Full proposal with explicit alternatives, rollback and blast radius; no promotion from an informal note.
semantics.confirmation_requirements: Confirmation A and B, each explicit and separate, recorded in gtt-completion.md.
semantics.documentation_depth: All six governed context files real, every technology row cited ([FUENTE] or a Locked-by ADR), a source manifest declared.
semantics.adr_expectations: An ADR for every change to governed context, including small ones; the stack map delta is exact.
semantics.change_process: Change request -> analysis -> proposal -> human decision -> promotion package -> human execution -> validation; no shortcuts.
semantics.validation_gates: gtt-validate.sh with provenance policy required; warnings block freeze.
semantics.freeze_expectations: Freeze only with a source manifest, every OPEN gap scoped and carrying `affects`, no BLOCKING gap, no unresolved conflict, no warning.
semantics.audit_requirements: gtt-audit before every promotion and on a schedule.
semantics.promotion_rigor: Promotion script reviewed by a second person where the team has one; hashes verified before and after.
semantics.evidence_requirements: Every verification claim recorded with command, result and evidence type; NO EVIDENCE stated for what was not run.
